title: Meng Tian
note: Qin general who directed the conquest of the Rong and Di, the expulsion of the Xiongnu from the Ordos Loop, the joining of the northern Great Wall, and construction of the Qin Straight Road (Zhidao).

title: Qin campaign against the Xiongnu and seizure of the Henan lands
note: Major northern offensive in 215–214 BCE led by Meng Tian with 300,000 troops, expelling the Xiongnu south of the Yellow River bend and establishing 34 frontier counties backed by river fortifications.

title: Construction of the Qin Straight Road (Zhidao)
note: Ancient military expressway surveyed and constructed across ridges from Yunyang (near Xianyang) to Jiuyuan (near Baotou) over roughly 700 km, enabling rapid logistical deployment of Qin troops to the northern Great Wall frontier.

title: Xiongnu Confederation
note: Nomadic pastoral empire of the Eurasian steppe unified under Modu Chanyu in 209 BCE, creating an enduring imperial rival to the Qin and Han dynasties across Central and Eastern Asia.
